name: bounty-hunt
author: BlaXun
description: Use a Bounty Marker, click any monster, and choose one of its drops to hunt. The rarer the drop, the more kills it takes -- up to a cap -- and then it is yours, guaranteed. Progress is saved on your character and survives a server restart.

settings.label: Rarity scale (kills = scale / drop rate)
settings.description: Kills needed = this divided by the drop's rate (in 0.01% units), clamped below. At 12000 a 0.02% drop takes 6000 kills and a 5% drop takes 24.

settings.label: Minimum kills
settings.description: Floor for common drops, so even a near-guaranteed drop still takes some effort. Set equal to Maximum kills for a fixed count.
